name: lead-magnet
description: Thiet ke thu mien phi de doi lay thong tin lien he — ma tran loai lead magnet theo giai doan nhan thuc, danh sach dinh dang hop VN (checklist, bang bao gia mau, mini-guide, quiz, file Google Sheet tinh san, buoi tu van hoac dung thu mien phi), bang quyet dinh co nen gate hay khong, xin thong tin gi, giao qua kenh nao, trang cam on, tin hieu chat luong lead, va thang cham diem 8 yeu to cho cong cu mien phi. Kích hoạt khi người dùng nhắc 'lead magnet', 'tang gi de lay so dien thoai', 'qua tang mien phi', 'tai lieu mien phi doi thong tin', 'moi mien phi', 'cong cu mien phi lay lead', 'chay lead ads ma khong biet tang gi'. Không dùng cho — lam trang dat lead magnet thi dung skill brief-landing-page; nuoi duong sau khi da co contact thi dung skill email-marketing; thiet ke goi ban tra tien thi dung skill offer-design.
